retrospective_revision_disclosure.disclosure: The switch from global scalar dev-macro-AUROC weighting (v8_r1) to per-class dev-logloss weighting (v8_r2) was triggered after inspecting sph_aha test Brier in v8_r1. Consequently, v8_r2 (and the legacy comparison arm in v8b) represents a retrospective re-evaluation on previously exposed public test folds, NOT 9 brand-new unexposed confirmatory tests. In v8b, the fixed v8_r2 fusion rule is held 100% unchanged with zero tuning on B_dev@5696_v3.

terminology_and_formula_disclosure.canonical_v8b_label: CNN and PRISM-XGB per-class probability post-fusion
terminology_and_formula_disclosure.executed_formula: p_fusion,k = sigmoid((1 - w_k) * logit(p_CNN,k) + w_k * logit(p_PRISM-XGB,k))
terminology_and_formula_disclosure.formula_note: The frozen v8_r2 implementation pools CNN and PRISM-XGB probabilities in logit space via bounded convex weights w_k in [0, 1] chosen by source dev binary cross-entropy (41-point grid; classes with <10 dev positives or negatives fall back to global dev-logloss w_global). Although Co-PI Round 2 prose shorthand wrote linear probability notation p_fusion,k = (1 - w_k) * p_CNN,k + w_k * p_PRISM-XGB,k, v8b keeps the exact frozen v8_r2 convex-logit post-fusion rule unmodified so there is zero change in fusion rule between legacy de4f2327 and B_dev@5696_v3.
terminology_and_formula_disclosure.zero_weight_interpretation: A learned weight w_prism,k = 0 (for example on heart-rate-defined sinus tachycardia/bradycardia classes in sph_aha) reflects predictive weighting under this specific beat-normalized PRISM + 10s raw 1D-CNN setup rather than absence of ECG morphology signal.

v8_r1.reason_for_revision: Inspection of sph_aha test Brier in v8_r1 revealed Brier degradation relative to standalone 1D-CNN because a single scalar AUROC-selected weight blended rhythm-dominated classes (e.g., sinus tachycardia/bradycardia) with beat-normalized PRISM probabilities.

v8_r2.fusion_rule: per_class_dev_logloss_convex_logit (bounded w_k in [0, 1] on 41-point grid, rare-class <10 fallback to global dev-logloss w)

v8b.purpose: Minimal 4-task / 3-cohort dictionary-version bridge comparing frozen zero-patient B_dev@5696_v3 against legacy dictionary_b.npz under the exact fixed v8_r2 pipeline.

ecgfounder_plus_prism_b.title_zh: ECGFounder（冻结特征）+ PRISM（特征拼接＋XGBoost）
ecgfounder_plus_prism_b.input_formula: 冻结 ECGFounder 嵌入 (1,024 维) ⊕ 冻结 PRISM 程序用量 (1,000 维) = 2,024 维
ecgfounder_plus_prism_b.v8_head_zh: 逐类 GPU XGBoost（max_depth=5, colsample_bytree=0.3, reg_lambda=2.0，仅源开发集早停）
ecgfounder_plus_prism_b.v7_head_zh: 固定 L2 逻辑回归（冻结特征线性头）
ecgfounder_plus_prism_b.mechanism_zh: ECGFounder 编码器权重与 PRISM 字典均保持冻结（new_foundation_encoder_fits=0），仅拼接 1,024+1,000 维特征并训练下游分类头。
ecgfounder_plus_prism_b.exposure_note: ECGFounder 预训练暴露：unknown；PRISM 字典：verified_unexposed。

xecg_plus_prism_b.title_zh: xECG（冻结特征）+ PRISM（特征拼接＋XGBoost）
xecg_plus_prism_b.input_formula: 冻结 xECG 嵌入（维度未在本地协议单列）⊕ 冻结 PRISM 程序用量 (1,000 维)
xecg_plus_prism_b.v7_head_zh: 固定 L2 逻辑回归
xecg_plus_prism_b.mechanism_zh: 冻结 xECG 表征与冻结 PRISM 用量横向拼接后输入下游分类头；本地公开协议未单列 xECG 池化维度。
xecg_plus_prism_b.exposure_note: xECG 预训练暴露：unknown；PRISM 字典：verified_unexposed。

cnn1d_plus_prism_xgb.input_formula: p_fusion,k = sigmoid((1 - w_k) * logit(p_CNN,k) + w_k * logit(p_PRISM-XGB,k))
cnn1d_plus_prism_xgb.v8_head_zh: 41 点均匀网格 w_k ∈ [0, 1]，按源开发集二元交叉熵选定；属 v8_r2 回顾性复评。
cnn1d_plus_prism_xgb.mechanism_zh: 从零端到端训练的 1D-CNN（10 秒 12 导联波形）与 PRISM-XGB 各自输出概率后在对数几率空间逐类凸组合。

cnn1d_plus_prism_e2e.title_zh: 1D-CNN + PRISM 双分支端到端训练
cnn1d_plus_prism_e2e.input_formula: 原始 12 导波形卷积分支 (ResNet1DSE) + 冻结 PRISM 1,000 维用量支路 → 联合读出头
cnn1d_plus_prism_e2e.v8_head_zh: 卷积分支与联合读出层端到端优化，PRISM 底层 1,000 字典保持冻结。
cnn1d_plus_prism_e2e.v7_head_zh: 仅在 v8 体系中评估。
cnn1d_plus_prism_e2e.mechanism_zh: 将冻结 PRISM 用量并入 ResNet1D-SE 末端联合反传。
cnn1d_plus_prism_e2e.exposure_note: 卷积分支从零训练，PRISM 字典为 verified_unexposed。

frozen_prism_b.input_formula: 冻结 1,000 维非负 PRISM 程序用量（零字典微调）
frozen_prism_b.v7_head_zh: 固定 L2 逻辑回归
frozen_prism_b.mechanism_zh: 仅使用 1,000 个冻结波形程序用量，无预训练基础模型。

frozen_ecgfounder.input_formula: 冻结 ECGFounder 嵌入 (1,024 维，无微调、无 PRISM 分支)
frozen_ecgfounder.v7_head_zh: 固定 L2 逻辑回归（冻结特征线性头）
frozen_ecgfounder.mechanism_zh: ECGFounder 编码器保持冻结（非全量微调），输出 1,024 维特征后由下游分类头判别，作为同基座单臂对照。

frozen_xecg.input_formula: 冻结 xECG 嵌入（维度未在本地协议单列，无 PRISM 分支）
frozen_xecg.v7_head_zh: 固定 L2 逻辑回归
frozen_xecg.mechanism_zh: 以冻结 xECG 特征训练单臂分类头，未做端到端微调。

waveform_cnn1d.input_formula: 原始 10 秒 12 导联波形 → ResNet1D-SE（从零端到端训练）
waveform_cnn1d.v8_head_zh: 端到端卷积网络 + 线性多标签头（本基准唯一端到端训练的原始波形单臂）
waveform_cnn1d.v7_head_zh: 仅在 v8 体系中评估。
waveform_cnn1d.mechanism_zh: 从随机初始化在源库原始 10 秒 12 导联波形上端到端训练。

afib_427_21_resolution.verdict: In DEV (n=3,441), conditional C2 over D1-D10 is positive (OR>1). In CONF (n=1,441), removing ECG-paced patients leaves the negative reversal intact; direction is sensitive to cohort split and adjustment specification, and finite-sample instability in D1 overlap is plausible but not uniquely established.

mimic_omr_bmi_weight_audit.definition: Strict pre-index OMR measurement (`0 < (index_ecg_date - chartdate) <= 365 days`), direct BMI (kg/m2) prioritized then same-day Weight+Height derived.

product_architecture_recommendation.layer_1_core_score: Pure ECG H_10 (0-100, zero demographic input; uncontaminated physiological cardiac load index).
product_architecture_recommendation.layer_2_peer_context: Optional Age/Sex conditional peer percentile (100 * F_dev(H_10 | age, sex)) showing standing vs same-age/sex reference peers.
product_architecture_recommendation.layer_3_clinical_risk: Endpoint-specific risk calculator (e.g., 365-day mortality risk = H_10 + Age + Sex, optionally + pre-index BMI when measured; falls back cleanly to AH when BMI unavailable).

supplement_11_lead_bootstrap_ci.setting_note: Synchronized standard hospital 12-lead ECG electrodes on MIMIC observed_confirmation (not bipolar smartwatch chest placement).

mimic_confirmation_disease_burden_5bin.caveat: H_10 development used organ burden and D1-D10 used development-set clinical diagnoses, and MIMIC labels reflect concurrent encounter diagnostic coding. These confirmation-set gradients therefore quantify multi-system medical record burden on independent patients (n=22,245), not an independent biological discovery.

calibration_vs_distillation_verdict.rationale: Empirically, Rung 2 (31-tap regularized FIR device transfer operator + identity-anchored coordinate calibration; 0.285 KB overhead on top of the frozen 221 KB INT8 dictionary) matches or outperforms exploratory Rung 3 distillation at equal n_cal on fixed held-out patients (SJLIFE H_10 MAE: Rung 2b=11.30 vs Rung 3a=11.25 [gain 95% CI [-0.4603, 0.57]], Rung 3b=10.63 [gain 95% CI [0.0238, 1.3018]]; wECGdb H_10 MAE: Rung 2b=10.38 vs Rung 3a=12.67 [gain 95% CI [-3.7267, -0.8087]], Rung 3b=12.31 [gain 95% CI [-3.5833, -0.2228]]), while requiring >500x less calibration memory.

target_threshold_accounting.honest_threshold_status: On sjlife_apple_watch_full30, primary Rung 2 reduces H_10 MAE to 11.30 pts (95% CI [9.7259, 12.9344]), which STILL exceeds the pre-specified MAE 95% CI upper <= 10.0 pts threshold; physiological/acquisition variance (e.g., asynchronous posture change or dry wrist electrode impedance/geometry shift) is reduced but NOT eliminated.

On wecgdb_LA_A_10s, primary Rung 2 reduces H_10 MAE to 10.38 pts (95% CI [7.9222, 13.0628]), which STILL exceeds the pre-specified MAE 95% CI upper <= 10.0 pts threshold; physiological/acquisition variance (e.g., asynchronous posture change or dry wrist electrode impedance/geometry shift) is reduced but NOT eliminated.

direct_waveform_d10.honest_interpretation_note: Paired difference vs Direct-Waveform Supervised 10D on equal-stem MIMIC 589 is +0.36 pp (95% CI [-2.71, +3.38] pp) for canonical PRISM D1-D10 (1,014D) and +0.30 pp (95% CI [-2.78, +3.37] pp) for pure-morphology PRISM D1-D10 (1,000D); at least one 95% CI exceeds the pre-specified +/-2.0 pp bound and is reported transparently.
